description: This file defines the class GrLineNode, which extends PcbNode and appears to represent a graphical line node associated with PCB layers, featuring a constructor that initializes its properties and retrieves a layer node.

classes.name: GrLineNode
classes.description: A class representing a graphical line node within a PCB layer, extending PcbNode and containing a reference to its layer node.
